meta.title: Miguel Bonilla | Full Stack AI Engineer
meta.description: Full Stack AI Engineer based in Bogotá. I build APIs, n8n and CRM automations, and LLM-powered systems. Open to remote work.

hero.lede: I turn business processes into software that works: secure APIs, n8n and CRM automations, and systems that use language models.
hero.sigilTitle: Miguel Bonilla's symbol: a transmutation circle with a circuit-trace M

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm in my ninth semester of Systems Engineering at Universidad de San Buenaventura in Bogotá, and I've worked as a Full Stack Developer at Coordenadas.co since September 2025.
about.p2: My day-to-day work sits between code and business operations: I integrate CRMs and APIs, build automations with n8n, Make and GoHighLevel, and ship the web platforms that use them.
about.p3: Outside work I build with language models. I made an academic document generator that runs on local LLMs through Ollama, and I'm now building a LangGraph agent that drafts my blog and publishes nothing without my approval.
about.portraitAlt: Pixel art portrait of Miguel Bonilla wearing glasses, a white shirt and a blue suit
